stock.description: Baozun Inc., operating through its subsidiaries, provides comprehensive e-commerce services to brand collaborators throughout the People's Republic of China. Their offerings span a wide range, including the development and integration of IT systems, creation and setup of online stores, management of daily operations for these digital storefronts, visual merchandising, marketing initiatives, customer assistance, and efficient warehousing and delivery of orders. The company supports partners across numerous product categories, such as clothing and accessories, various appliances, electronics, household furnishings, food and health items, beauty and cosmetic products, fast-moving consumer goods, mother and infant supplies, and automobiles. Established in 2007, the company was formerly known as Baozun Cayman Inc. before rebranding as Baozun Inc. in March 2015, and it is headquartered in Shanghai, People's Republic of China.
